reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as minor boron additions are known to enhance glass-forming ability and thermal stability in many metallic glass systems by increasing packing density and chemical complexity, though the specific interaction with phosphorus in high-entropy alloys is not yet proven.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with well-defined measurements (DSC, XRD, critical cooling rate) and a decisive falsification criterion, though practical determination of critical cooling rate can be challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful for researchers working on phosphorus-containing high-entropy metallic glasses, as it proposes a simple, testable compositional modification with a clear mechanistic rationale and boundary conditions.
